message: The other day, I found myself in a bit of a tug-of-war with my kids over our go-bags. They thought it was just a fun game to toss in their favorite toys while I was trying to keep things practical with water bottles and snacks. It reminded me that preparedness doesn’t have to be all serious business—sometimes it’s about getting everyone involved and making it a team effort. Now, I’m thinking of designating a ‘fun item’ slot in each bag to keep the kids engaged! How do you balance preparedness with keeping it light for your family? 😊
